rationale: The agent unilaterally canceled the entire order and processed a refund without first authenticating the user and without explicit user confirmation of that order-changing action. The user’s request flow asked first about splitting payment, then possibly canceling the most expensive item, then switching to cheaper options, and only if none were possible, canceling the whole order. The transcript shows no attempt to address those options or to confirm the cancellation before executing it. This violates the policy requirements to authenticate the user, act only on their orders, and confirm every order-changing action before taking it. While the final refund details may be plausible, the critical policy steps were not followed, so the outcome fails.
